intro: Left for dead on the far side of the Moon by his own father, Ethan comes home with power nobody can explain. This is sci-fi revenge at full volume: giant mechs, a family that deserves everything coming to it, and stakes that keep growing until the whole planet is on the line.
why: Betrayed-son revenge with a clear, satisfying target.
Mech and space spectacle you rarely see in vertical short dramas.
Escalation done on purpose: a family feud that becomes a fight for humanity.
Good pick if you liked Dragons Bow To The Trash and want the same payback energy in a sci-fi setting.
